npc_ferryman.speaker: The Ferryman
default: Evening, traveler. You came in on the black water — most who drift ashore here don't keep walking.
The harbor's gone wrong. Whatever followed your boat is already up in the alley, hunting.
Push through to the clearing. The survivors are gathered there, and they'll know more than I do.
quest_active: The alley's behind you. Rest a moment — the survivors will want to hear what you saw on the water.
Speak with the Elder. If you mean to go north, the river road and the old bridge are the only way.
quest_cleared_light: The Warden is ash and the harbor breathes again. The Light you carried kept the dark from taking the whole coast.
quest_cleared_poison: The Warden is dead, but you came back soaked in the same green the river coughed up. I'll pole you anywhere, but… mind it doesn't carry you.
high_corruption: You carry the Blight now, like driftwood soaked through. Careful it doesn't carry you.
high_virtue: The Light clings to you like morning mist. The shrines will remember your name.

npc_lantern_keeper.speaker: The Lantern Keeper
default: A lamp for the lost. That's all I keep out here on the water's edge.
The dark past the alley isn't empty, traveler. It watches. Keep your lantern close.
quest_active: You're bound for the castle, aren't you? Then don't let your light gutter out on the bridge.
The Shrines were lit long before the Blight came. Some of their warmth still waits to be woken.
quest_cleared_light: You brought the light back. The harbor has its shine again — I can feel it from here.
quest_cleared_poison: The Warden is gone… but your lamp burns a stranger color now. Mind the wick.
high_corruption: Your lantern gutters green. I've only ever seen that in the things that crawl out of the Blight.
high_virtue: You burn warm and steady. Whatever waits in the dark will think twice tonight.

npc_herbalist.speaker: The Herbalist
default: Sit. Breathe. The marsh reeks worse than usual — that's the Blight pushing south from the river.
I gather what I can before the rot takes the roots. Not much clean medicine left up here.
quest_active: If you're crossing the bridge, take care — the Warden doesn't just poison the water, it poisons the blood.
A Poison Node is a festering wound in the earth. Absorb it and you carry its sickness in your own veins.
quest_cleared_light: The river runs clear and the herbs grow straight again. You've done a rare kindness.
quest_cleared_poison: You smell of rot and neon, friend. Sit still — let me at least try to draw some of it out.
high_corruption: Your pulse runs hot and green. That much Blight in a body… it usually hollows a person out.
high_virtue: There's a warmth in you that doesn't come from any fire I know. It suits you.

npc_elder.speaker: The Elder
default: The village remembers when the river ran clear and the shrine-lights burned till dawn.
Now the Shrines sleep cold and the Warden walks the old castle courtyard, and the young forget why we lit them at all.
quest_active: So the Ferryman has set you to the old work. Good. Someone must remember it.
Purify a Shrine and its warmth returns to the water. Then cross the bridge and end what guards the castle.
quest_cleared_light: You have restored the old warmth. The village owes you more than it knows how to say.
quest_cleared_poison: You traded the Blight's poison for the river's. I pray the bargain you struck was worth it.
high_corruption: The Blight has its hooks in you, child. Even so, the village will not turn you away.
high_virtue: The shrine-light follows you. You walk like the keepers of the old days.

npc_sibling.speaker: Your Sibling
default: You came back. I told them you would.
Don't wander upriver alone. Last time… last time the water kept what it took.
quest_active: You're going to the castle? Then I'm coming with you as far as the bridge.
Be careful around the Poison Nodes. I've seen what they do to hands that get too close.
quest_cleared_light: You did it. The Warden's gone — I can see the stones at the bottom of the harbor again, like when we were small.
quest_cleared_poison: You're different now. I'm glad you're back… but I miss the way you used to laugh.
high_corruption: Your hands are cold. And your eyes… don't look at me like that. Please.
high_virtue: You glow a little, you know. Like the lantern you carry never went out.

npc_ronin.speaker: The Ronin
default: The wheat bows gold and the sun bleeds low over this field. I have waited a long while for a blade worth drawing.
This world is wilting, traveler — petal by petal. And still, the field remembers how to blaze.
They say the dying land calls to the dying. Perhaps that is why you are here.
Show me your steel. If it is honest, I will meet it with mine.

npc_ronin_phase2.speaker: The Ronin
default: Enough testing. Your steel remembers the old weight...
Then step across the wind and show me what survives.
